correctness.rationale: Replayed RESULT.md lines 21–44 for the precise operation (reverse block order, not letters). A suffix of the source ends at a 1 and starts with at most m zeros, while a prefix starts at a 1 and ends with at most m zeros. Hence no joining to another block can extend the initial or final zero run beyond the respective bound. For any permitted p,q,r,s let A=m−s, B=m−p. Then q+r=A+B. Take i=max(0,q−B), j=B+i−q; the bounds 0≤i≤A and 0≤j≤B follow from 0≤q≤A+B. The five pieces 1·0^s, 0^(A−i), 0^i·1·0^j, 0^(B−j), 0^p·1 concatenate to the source, and reversing their order gives the prescribed gaps because B−j+i=q and A−i+j=r. Dropping any empty zero-only pieces preserves both concatenations, also at m=0. The gaps describe distinct outputs uniquely, so the count is Σ_{p,s=0}^m(2m−p−s+1)=(m+1)^3; subtracting the two disjoint endpoint violations from the unrestricted stars-and-bars count agrees. The ratio tends to 3/4. Independent enumeration of all 256 masks for m=3 gave exactly the 64 predicted words, not merely the same size (bounded replay: /workspace/branches/543fc415-d8b7-470d-b666-98df41c39a0a/independent_m3.py). Frozen check.py was read, not executed; its m≤7 range is finite and limited to equal gaps despite a helper function taking two parameters.

value.rationale: This is a motivated small-weight but unbounded family for a standard word operation. The structural result is saturation of the whole endpoint-constrained set, not a few counts or an arbitrary sample. It gives both a witness partition for every reachable word and an exact benchmark for the density among all words of the same weight.
